en.summary: A KuCoin lucky draw for brand-new users who join through the official announcement link on KuCoin's social channels. One of the prizes is a Futures Position Airdrop: you're given a ready-made futures position; if it loses, you owe nothing, and you can withdraw at most $2 USDT of profit (5% of the position value).
steps: Open the campaign only through the official announcement link from a KuCoin social channel (e.g. Telegram, X, Reddit, Discord) — otherwise you're not eligible.
Register a new KuCoin account — the campaign is only for brand-new users.
Complete the conditions on the campaign page to enter the Lucky Draw. The rules text doesn't list the tasks, amounts or deadlines — check the page.
If you win a Futures Position Airdrop, close the position to take any profit (max $2 USDT).

payout.when: The rules don't give the campaign dates, when the draw takes place, when prizes are credited, or any claim deadline. Check the campaign page.
payout.form: Lucky Draw prizes 'include' a Futures Position Airdrop — a ready-made futures position. If it makes a loss, you owe nothing. When you close it, you can withdraw at most $2 USDT of profit (5% of the position value). The rules don't list the other prizes.
payout.how: The rules don't say where the airdropped position appears or whether you need to claim it manually. Profit becomes withdrawable when you close the position.

watch: Only brand-new users, and only via the official announcement link.
The most you can withdraw from the position is $2 USDT of profit; the position itself can't be withdrawn.
Zero-fee trades don't count toward transaction volume.
Disqualification for wash trading (trading with yourself to fake volume), mass account registrations or unusual trading patterns. One person, one account.
The rules have no dates: the campaign could end at any time — check the page.
Make sure the link really comes from KuCoin's official channel: fake links can lead to phishing sites.
KuCoin keeps the right to the final interpretation of the rules. Apple Inc. is not a sponsor and is not affiliated with the event.

faq.q: Can I lose money on the airdropped futures position?
faq.a: According to the rules, no: if the position makes a loss, you owe nothing.
From the Futures Position Airdrop, at most $2 USDT of profit. The rules text doesn't list other prizes.

faq.q: I already have a KuCoin account. Can I join?
faq.a: No. The campaign is only for brand-new registered users.
No. Volume from zero-fee trades isn't counted.

faq.q: Why do the rules mention Apple?
faq.a: They only say Apple isn't a sponsor or affiliated. The full prize list isn't in the text, so don't count on any particular prize.

faq.q: Do I need KYC, and are any countries excluded?
faq.a: The rules text doesn't mention KYC or regions. Check the campaign page before joining.
